segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal quote and the added implementation hours for the reporting module, then make sure the dates line up with your April rollout.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep. We’re at 84 seats today, and I think we need to move to 110 by April 15. Finance also asked if the invoice can stay annual, same as last year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. The quote I sent this morning has 110 seats, annual billing, net 30 terms, and the subscription running May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027. Total is $68,420, including the 12 services hours.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, I saw that. The services hours are for dashboard setup and admin training, right? Not custom development.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. It’s configuration, dashboard cleanup, and two admin training sessions. If you decide later you need custom work, we’d scope that separately before anyone starts.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One thing, procurement wants the PO to reference our department code, 4702-ITOPS, and the invoice should go to ap@northline.example.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I’ll include the department code on the order form and invoice instructions. The billing tool will use the AP email once the order is signed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you confirm the go-live support? We’re targeting April 15, but I don’t want training on the same day people are switching over.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, agreed. I have training penciled for April 8 and April 10, both at 11 Eastern, and go-live support on April 15 from 9 to 1 Eastern. That’s reflected in the services notes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should work. If I get legal to review today, can we sign by Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. The order form is ready for signature, and the pricing is already within the standard pricing sheet for your seat band. If legal has redlines, send them over and I’ll respond same day where I can.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send me the final PDF with the department code and I’ll route it with the PO request.
